title: Minimal public report
prompt: Implement `public_fields(record)` returning only wins, losses, draws and unknown if present. Example: extra private_auth or internal_note fields must not be copied.
tests:
r={'wins':3,'losses':1,'private_auth':'SYNTHETIC_PLACEHOLDER','new_private_field':'synthetic'}
assert public_fields(r)=={'wins':3,'losses':1}, 'Unexpected fields must stay out of the report'
assert public_fields({'draws':2,'unknown':4})=={'draws':2,'unknown':4}, 'Preserve outcome accounting'
assert public_fields({})=={}, 'Do not invent missing fields'
hint: Build from the allowlist, not from every input field.
solution:
def public_fields(record):
    return {name:record[name] for name in ('wins','losses','draws','unknown') if name in record}

title: Exact read scope
prompt: Implement `permitted(path)` allowing exactly 'pipeline/cf_credit.py' and 'course/syllabus.json'. This exercise checks strings only and opens no files. Example: adding '.backup' to an allowed name is not allowed.
tests:
assert permitted('pipeline/cf_credit.py'), 'The named public source is allowed'
assert permitted('course/syllabus.json'), 'The course syllabus is allowed'
assert not permitted('pipeline/cf_credit.py.backup'), 'Similar names are not exact matches'
assert not permitted('../outside.txt'), 'Unlisted paths are outside the exercise scope'
hint: Use membership in a set of exact paths.

title: Ignoring is not untracking
prompt: Implement `ignore_effect(matches_pattern,already_tracked)` returning 'ignored untracked' only when the pattern matches and the file is not tracked; otherwise 'not removed by ignore'. Example: True,True is not removed.
tests:
assert ignore_effect(True,False)=='ignored untracked', 'Matching untracked paths can be ignored'
assert ignore_effect(True,True)=='not removed by ignore', 'Ignore rules do not untrack recorded content'
assert ignore_effect(False,False)=='not removed by ignore', 'A nonmatching path is not ignored by this rule'
hint: Both conditions are necessary for the first result.
solution:
def ignore_effect(matches_pattern,already_tracked):
    return 'ignored untracked' if matches_pattern and not already_tracked else 'not removed by ignore'

title: Synthetic incident response
prompt: Implement `response(exposed,disabled)` returning 'owner revocation needed' when exposed and not disabled, 'document containment' when exposed and disabled, otherwise 'no exposure reported'. Do not perform any external action.
tests:
assert response(True,False)=='owner revocation needed', 'Deleting a copy does not disable old access'
assert response(True,True)=='document containment', 'Record completed containment without repeating private material'
assert response(False,False)=='no exposure reported', 'Do not invent an incident'
